text_or_item: On plant C2t, holding the B3-A equilibrium xi*(d) with the real E8 actuator channels (governor reference, exciter reference, GFM PIplim_y/PIqlim_y) needs effective references that differ from Pset = P*, Qset = Q*: the governor reference includes armature losses and the GFM Q reference must include (V* - vref_pre)/Qdrp because E8 leaves the GFM voltage reference unchanged. With those references applied together with the load step (no RDC) the plant settles at xi* (P 3e-5, Q 2e-5, V 9e-7 pu, f 1.6e-6 Hz after 150 s). The centered field v_nom vanishes at xi* and its offset jumps by up to 0.26 pu/s (P) and 0.015 pu/s (Q) when the reference is updated from xi_pre to xi*(d). For S0 the reference is xi_pre.

action: Await human review (DEC-038); weight sensitivity and dynamic B2-B3 comparison not run.
